statements.text: He should not trust touch alone to say whether the desk top is hot or cold.
After the cool plate and warm lamp, each hand may judge the same desk top differently.
Touch always gives the true temperature of the desk top, so no thermometer is needed.

stem: Ishaan holds his left hand on a cool steel plate from the fridge and his right hand near a warm desk lamp. Then he places both hands on the same wooden desk top.

teacher.key_rationale: After opposite cool and warm exposures, touch can mislead about the same surface. A measured temperature is the reliable check.
